lanes.summary: The diff does what PMAT-4798 asks. J is the newest commit within ranks 0..MAX_LAG (6) on which every verdict lane that has a producer has a green or red run. The candidates come from a rank list read in the same query (history(first: 7)); the head is rank 0 and appears once. A rank list whose rank 0 is not C is ignored. All lanes are picked on the one J (RH[r] != J). When no commit qualifies, J = C. The line prints "(judged, head, lag k commits)" when J is not the head. A red on J counts as measured, so moving J cannot pick a commit just because it is green. The release path is not touched. The receipt's counts match the tree: 70 `row` calls in self_test, and 53 planted mutants (m01..m53). I did not run the self-test or the mutants, as the lane rules require, so 70/70 and 53/53 killed are the receipt's claims. Two cosmetic leftovers, neither a refutation. Note: the paiml-lane-witness file does not exist at /home/noah/src/aprender/.git/worktrees/aprender-w4798/paiml-lane-witness (also searched with a glob), so I left tree_witness empty. agy-lane.sh may void this lane for that reason.

findings.claim: A lane counts as covered on a commit (HAS) if any completed green or red run exists there. The per-lane pick, however, takes the newest non-void run on J. So if a newer run on J is still pending, J can be chosen and that lane then reads not_measured, while an older commit within the cap had every lane complete. The ticket's wording ('has a measured run') allows this, and it fails closed, so it is not a defect.
findings.fix: Optional: build HAS from the same newest-non-void pick the final pass uses, so the chosen J never yields a pending lane.

findings.claim: The not_measured reason text still says 'no run on C' although the lane is now judged on J. This is cosmetic: J equals C unless the line carries a lag note.
findings.fix: Change the text to 'no run on the judged commit'.
